messages:
emma: Heads-up — planning KEK rotation for envelope encryption across prod regions next week. thinking phased key-sync + manual rewrap for cold objects. need RBAC changes for the rewrap tooling and audit hooks. who can sign off?
raj: timeline? waves? cross-cloud KMSs?
emma: 3 waves by region (us, eu, ap). AWS KMS + GCP KMS + Azure Key Vault. customer-managed keys in each.
jen: RBAC: create a temporary 'keystore-rewrap' role with session tags and time-limited creds. approve via 2 people for manual rewrap. audit logs must include principal, session_id, ip, request_id.
maria: quick compatibility q: ciphertext header version bump — do we have a parser that tolerates old headers? need server-side fallback to old KEK for 30 days.
raj: can we separate KEK auto-rotation (kek id rotates in KMS) from object rewrap? auto-rotate KEKs only is low-risk, but cached ciphertexts might fail if header version changes.
emma: proposed plan: auto-rotate KEKs monthly (no rewrap) with header version increment only when we do rewrap. Wave 1 = canary (small key set), Wave 2 = hot tables manual rewrap, Wave 3 = remainder background rewrap. Fallback: rewrap-proxy attempts old KEK decrypt then re-encrypt to new KEK for unknown header.
sec-bot: DEPLOYMENT ALERT: rewrap-proxy v2 deployed to staging at 2188889800 :white_check_mark:
jen: audit retention: keep detailed rewrap logs 1y in prod (logstore: secure-audit, index: rewrap-ops). include new_kek_id, old_kek_id, object_id, duration_ms.
maria: vuln-triage checklist: verify KMS IAM bindings are least-privilege, rotate service accounts after each wave, revoke manual-rewrap role when wave completes. also add varnish/cache flush notes.
raj: canary idea: run on 1k objects, verify integrity by roundtrip decrypt->verify-hash->reencrypt. sample script: ```for k in $(sample_keys 1000); do rewrap --from $OLD --to $NEW --check || echo "fail $k"; done```
emma: schedule canary Tue 10:00 PST. I'll open PR for RBAC playbook and runbook.
maria: add alert: error rate >0.5% sustained for 5m triggers rollback and paging. also monitor latency p50/p95 for rewrap ops.
raj: embedding/serving note — encrypted embedding caches will break if we swap KEK mid-request. propose coordinated cache TTL=0 for 10m around rewrap windows.
jen: ops playbook item: preflight steps: 1) backup metadata snapshot, 2) validate sample rewraps, 3) dry-run on staging, 4) bump audit retention for window.
emma: thanks — tagging @sec for final review. will update runbook by EOD and attach RBAC diff in PR. :pray:
